Container.Name: vpn-gateway
Container.Overview: OpenVPN-only gateway with default-deny firewall and configurable LAN WebUI access. Release candidate: cross-VLAN WebUI support; validate disconnect and leak behavior before production use. Supports Unraid Custom: eth0.72 with a fixed IP when configured in the UI.

Config.Name: Credentials directory
Config.Description: Optional auth.txt with username on first line, password on second

Config.Name: VPN_AUTH_FILE
Config.Description: Leave blank if config does not require auth file

Config.Name: DNS_SERVERS
Config.Description: Comma separated IPv4 DNS servers routed through VPN

Config.Name: LAN_CIDRS
Config.Description: Comma-separated authorized client IPv4 CIDRs; creates specific return routes via underlay router

Config.Name: LAN_GATEWAY
Config.Description: Optional underlay router IPv4 for cross-VLAN return routes; blank detects eth0 default gateway

Config.Name: LAN_TCP_PORTS
Config.Description: Comma separated TCP ports accessible from configured LAN CIDRs

Config.Name: LAN_UDP_PORTS
Config.Description: Comma separated UDP ports accessible from LAN
